title: Vegetarian Crumble Tacos
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make vegetarian taco recipe with a crumbly crust. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients.amount: 2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and diced

instructions: In a large bowl, toss diced sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of lime juice and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add vegetarian crumble to the skillet and cook until lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning roasted sweet potatoes, crumble mixture, and chopped cilantro onto a tortilla. Serve with salsa and shredded cheese on top.
